description: Create a manual, non-renewing subscription record for a member. Use a subscription action link for provider-backed recurring billing.

amount.description: Override amount per cycle (otherwise derived from tier)

currency.description: ISO currency code (otherwise derived from tier or company default)

currentPeriodEnd.description: Period end (ISO 8601). Defaults to start + cycle.

tierId.description: Membership tier ID — if set, amount/currency default from the tier

name: create_subscription

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
